01. How many years of continuous full-time paid professional experience performing commercial grounds-keeping and gardening duties do you have? Options: 1 year or less | 2 - 3 years | 4 - 5 years | More than 5 years
02. Do you possess a valid California driver's license or can you obtain one prior to appointment? Options: Yes | No
Must possess a current valid California Department of Motor Vehicle Driver’s License.
Two (2) years of continuous full-time paid professional experience performing commercial grounds-keeping and gardening duties.

Examples of duties may include, but are not limited to, the following: •Serves as lead worker of a small grounds crew. •Inspects assigned areas to detect grounds maintenance problems and checks for vandalism. •Plans and assigns work of Groundsworker-Gardeners, student help, and/or the seasonal labor. •Maintains records of equipment use and chemicals used. •Schedules watering programs. •Checks work of crew members and keeps supervisor informed of any special problems that arise with equipment or personnel. •Performs minor maintenance and repair to power mowers, edgers, rototillers, and vacuum sweepers. •Performs all of the duties contained in the essential and marginal job functions of the Groundsworker – Gardener position. •Performs other related duties as assigned.
Must be insurable under Peralta Community College District's current insurance policy.
